questions.q: Which of the following does not illustrate the effect of temperature or pressure on gas solubility?
options: Air bubbles form on the sides of a warm glass of water
Soda pop is bottled under pressure
Air is more humid on rainy days
questions.answer: Air is more humid on rainy days
